fightSong.title: Toasted
fightSong.lyrics: Breaded, fried, and golden brown / Toasted Raviolis take the crown / Dip it once, dip it twice / St. Louis flavor, oh so nice!

stadium.name: The Fryer
stadium.tradition: The Toss — toasted ravs are tossed into the crowd pre-game. Catch one, get free appetizers for a year at a local spot.

fanCulture.description: They argue about marinara vs ranch dip. After wins they chant 'EXTRA CRISPY.' It's very St. Louis.

rivalries.name: The Midwest Munch
rivalries.narrative: Deep dish vs toasted rav. Carbs vs carbs.

cityFlavor: Arch, blues, and fried pasta. Don't ask, just eat.
